run_deformable_cloth_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that loads a cloth soft body and steps the physics loop
create_soft_body_anchor: create soft body anchors on a cloth mesh to pin nodes to fixed positions or rigid bodies
load_soft_body_cloth: load a soft body cloth mesh from an OBJ file with mass spring and bending spring parameters
get_mesh_data_simulation: get the simulation mesh vertex data from a soft body to inspect node positions at runtime
configure_physics_engine_parameter: configure the physics engine sparse SDF voxel size parameter for soft body collision resolution
